A valuable '''bangle''' was commissioned by a [[Unidentified crime lord (bangle)|crime lord]] for his [[Unidentified crimelord's daughter|daughter's]] [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. However, the bangle was stolen by a [[Unidentified jewel thief|jewel thief]] from the [[Unidentified jeweler|jeweler]] who made it, and it was later sold to the crime lord for a reduced price.<ref name="Too Hot to Handle" />
